title: OpenAI · 更新日志来源更新
summary: 新增一条 changelog，内容为 API Organization 设置中新增 HIPAA 合规支持流程，日期标注为 2026 年 10 月。

added_lines: Added an in-product flow for HIPAA compliance support in API Organization settings > General. Admins of eligible organizations can now accept the standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and enable HIPAA compliance support for their organization. See the Help Center for eligibility, covered services, and configuration requirements.
